summary: Iteration 6: Verified Stripe portal endpoint, Stripe checkout regression, auth gating, plan-gated Schedule C, ManageSubscription UI card, overflow-free /app/vault and /app/mileage at 430x932, and full nav testids. 6/6 backend pytest passed (1 skipped due to unrelated verify-receipt bug), all frontend acceptance checks passed.

minor.issue: Sandbox-fallback path raises KeyError: '_id' — uses user['_id'] but user dict is keyed by 'id'. Returns 500 to iOS clients in Sandbox/TestFlight when Apple creds not configured. server.py line 2077. Not part of this iteration's changes but discovered while trying to upgrade a test user to pro.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix verify-receipt sandbox path in server.py:2077 — change user['_id'] to user['id'] so TestFlight/sandbox IAP upgrades don't 500.
critical_code_review_comments: ManageSubscription.jsx: clean, uses toast for errors, has proper testids, apple deep-link opens in new tab as required by Apple guidelines.

server.py /stripe/portal: correct — lazy customer creation, meaningful 502 message referencing dashboard.stripe.com/test/settings/billing/portal, no stack-trace leak. Portal is actually configured in test mode (real billing.stripe.com URL returned).
server.py /reports/schedule-c.pdf: NOW plan-gated (trial/basic → 402) — closes the gap noted in iteration_5.
test_credentials: Ephemeral TEST_it6_* and TEST_ui6_* users created per-run via /api/auth/register + /api/onboarding/complete.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed users only; no cleanup endpoint but safe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe billing portal IS configured in test mode (returns real billing.stripe.com URL). Backend /reports/schedule-c.pdf gating verified (trial→402). To upgrade a user to pro for testing you cannot use /subscriptions/verify-receipt due to KeyError bug at server.py:2077. To bypass onboarding+splash: localStorage.milli_token=<token>, milli_selected_plan={plan:'pro'}, milli_onboarding_complete='true', sessionStorage.milli_splash_seen='1'.
